faqs.q: What is the Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket used for?
faqs.a: The Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket is a braided rope sling with a protective jacket for heavy lifts, listed in sizes 72 mm to 288 mm. The size table gives each size its minimum breaking load in kN and tonnes, weight per metre and Indus part number.

faqs.q: How do I read Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket part numbers such as IH-LR-SY-BRHSJ-72MM?
faqs.a: IH-LR-SY-BRHSJ-72MM is the 72 mm size, 463 t minimum breaking load, IH-LR-SY-BRHSJ-182MM the 182 mm size, 2653 t minimum breaking load and IH-LR-SY-BRHSJ-288MM the 288 mm size, 6280 t minimum breaking load. The size table lists every Indus part number with its own dimensions and rating, so quote the full part number rather than the series name.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket come in?
faqs.a: The Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket is listed in sizes 72 mm to 288 mm, each under its own Indus part number with weight per metre and breaking load.

faqs.q: How should I pick the size of Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket for my job?
faqs.a: Choose by the minimum breaking load and the hitch the sling will be used in, then pick the row in the Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket table: the sizes run 72 mm to 288 mm. For heavy lifts, send the load, hitch and sling angle on the RFQ so the rating is confirmed.

faqs.q: What load rating does the Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket carry?
faqs.a: The listing gives minimum breaking loads of 4,538 to 61,540 kN, set by size, rather than a working load limit. A breaking load is a test figure: the working load limit is what the manufacturer rates for the hitch, so ask on the RFQ for the working load limit you need. See [our guide to working load limit versus breaking strength](/blog/working-load-limit-vs-breaking-strength) for the difference.

faqs.q: What is the Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket made from and how is it finished?
faqs.a: The listing for the Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket gives the construction as a braided rope sling with a jacket but does not state the fibre. Ask on the RFQ and we confirm the rope material and jacket from the maker before you order.

faqs.q: What standard and certificate apply to the Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket?
faqs.a: The Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket ships with the manufacturer's test certificate for each consignment. For third-party certification or witnessed proof testing, say so on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Which parts connect to the Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket?
faqs.a: The Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket works with shackles and hooks sized for its eye; heavy-lift shackles are listed on our Lifting & Rigging pages, and lighter slings are on the [synthetic slings shelf](/c/synthetic-slings) and [wire rope slings](/c/wire-rope-slings). Quote the load and the connection you plan.

faqs.q: How should the Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket be fitted and inspected?
faqs.a: Protect the Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket from sharp edges and check the jacket and rope for cuts and abrasion before each lift; [our lifting equipment inspection guide](/blog/lifting-equipment-inspection-uae) explains the inspection routine. Remove it from service if it is damaged.

faqs.q: How does the Braided Rope Heavy-Lift Sling with Jacket compare with a polyester round sling?
faqs.a: The braided rope heavy-lift sling is the heavy-duty option on the shelf, listed by minimum breaking load up to 4,538 to 61,540 kN, while the [Polyester Round Sling — Eye and Eye](/p/polyester-round-sling-eye-and-eye) lists a working load limit of 1 t to 100 t. For a stated working load limit and a standard colour code, the round sling is the simpler choice.

faqs.q: What is the Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook used for?
faqs.a: The Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook is a clevis belt hook fitted to the eye of a web or round sling to attach it to the load or hook. It is listed in sizes 2.2 t, each size under its own Indus part number.

faqs.q: How do I read Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook part numbers such as IH-LR-SY-G80CBH-2P2T?
faqs.a: IH-LR-SY-G80CBH-2P2T and IH-LR-SY-G80CBH-2P2T are two of the part numbers in the size table, each with its own dimensions. Quote the full Indus part number from the table, or the size you need, so the right row is supplied.

faqs.q: What size range does the Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook cover?
faqs.a: Sizes on the Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook run 2.2 t. The size table gives each one its own Indus part number and dimensions, and the [synthetic slings shelf](/c/synthetic-slings) lists the neighbouring products.

faqs.q: How should I pick the size of Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook for my job?
faqs.a: Pick the size by the working load limit the sling must carry, then check the opening and pin or eye dimensions in the Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook table against the sling eye and the hook or ring it connects to. Quote the Indus part number.

faqs.q: What is the rated capacity of the Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook?
faqs.a: The Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook lists a working load limit of 2.2 t, set per size in the table in the unit the manufacturer rates it in. The working load limit is the most the part may carry in service; proof and breaking loads are test figures and never working limits.

faqs.q: What is the Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook made from and how is it finished?
faqs.a: The Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook is made from alloy steel and finished powder coated. The powder-coated alloy steel body is graded 80 as stated on the listing.

faqs.q: What standard and certificate apply to the Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook?
faqs.a: The Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook ships with the manufacturer's test certificate for each consignment. For third-party certification or witnessed proof testing, say so on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Which parts connect to the Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook?
faqs.a: The Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook connects a web or round sling from the [synthetic slings shelf](/c/synthetic-slings) to the load or lifting point. For wire or chain alternatives, see the [wire rope slings](/c/wire-rope-slings) and [chain slings](/c/chain-slings).

faqs.q: How should the Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook be fitted and inspected?
faqs.a: Check the Grade 80 Clevis Belt Hook for wear, distortion and a free-moving latch or pin before each lift, and keep it within its working load limit. [Our lifting equipment inspection guide](/blog/lifting-equipment-inspection-uae) sets out what an inspection looks at.

In detail, size range is 2.2 t here and 1 t to 2.75 t there; rating is working load limit 2.2 t here and working load limit 1 to 2.75 t there.
